title: A transistor, enlarged
alt: A germanium transistor from the 1960s, seen at huge magnification: a small, rough metal block standing on a silver base, with a thin wire bent to a post, against a dark blue background.
author: Mister rf
description: Made by General Electric PNP germanium alloy transistor for universal purpose / fast switch. Pc: 0.15 W, Vce: 15 V, Ic max: 0.3 A, ft: 8 MHz
